title: Expanding ring (INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT=4)
close_reason: Added EXPANDING_RING = (4, 8, 15) constant to Python loadng module (messages.py), matching Rust and C implementations. Exported from __init__.py. The constant provides the spec B2.5 hop limits for progressive expanding ring route discovery: first attempt uses INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT=4, retries use 8 and 15 (MAX_HOP_LIMIT).
